purpose: Promote Vendor Sourcing from a permission-only shell into a production reference Vendor master with scalable directory search, company-scoped CRUD, contact persons, reversible lifecycle controls and immutable audit evidence while remaining fully isolated from Inventory, Payroll and Accounting.
schema_change_scope: Adds sourcing.SourcingVendorContact only; existing SourcingVendor identity is preserved.
isolation: Vendor records remain sourcing.SourcingVendor and never inventory.Supplier
No Vendor action creates stock, purchase, payable, payroll, worker or accounting records
Vendor contacts are sourcing-owned children only
all reads and mutations are scoped to request.company and explicit sourcing.vendors permissions
